entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I hope you can help. I bought this jersey a little while ago, and I... I'm just not sure what to do. The website was a bit overwhelming.
I can certainly help you with that. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the item or more of a preference issue?
I guess a preference? It's the wrong size. I always get a medium, but this one is just too tight in the shoulders. I tried to look online, but there were so many options. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can take care of this for you. It sounds like a simple exchange for the next size up would solve the problem. Let me just look up your order information.
Oh, would that work? That would be great.

Absolutely. I see your order right here. You purchased the Pro-Line jersey, and it was delivered 21 days ago. That's perfectly within our 90-day return window, so we can definitely get this sorted out for you.
Wait, 90 days? Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried I was too late.

Not at all. I can process this exchange for you right now. I'm also going to email you a pre-paid return label. Now, because you're a VIP member with VeloFit, I'm authorized to ship your new jersey out today with complimentary two-day shipping. You won't have to wait for us to receive the original item.
You can do that? Wow. That's... so much easier. Thank you so much, Diana! You've really helped me out.

It is my pleasure. The confirmation for your new shipment and the return label for the one that's too tight should be in your inbox within the next five minutes. Was there anything else I could assist with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for being a VeloFit customer, and have a wonderful day.
